# Ai (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

AI model providers (Models & keys) and the model calls: retries, repair, tool steps and the offline rules provider.

## Files

- `llm.ts`: One call shape for every provider: send a system prompt and a user message, force a single structured answer that matches a JSON schema, get tokens back.
- `provider-routes.ts`: AI model providers (Models & Keys): list, test, add, update and remove.
- `providers.ts`: Model providers: storage, key handling, connection tests and model discovery.
